readout_other: on-chip microelectrode firing frequency, platinum resistor temperature, Ca2+ and ROS imaging, viability
direction_notes: US1 and US2 reduced epileptic neuron firing frequency and temperature oscillation; US3 and US4 had no therapeutic effect.
safety_notes: LIPUS parameters US1-US4 showed no apoptosis, necrosis or cytoskeletal disruption in normal neurons.

exposures.label: On-chip LIPUS (US1-US4) on epileptic cultured neurons

device.model: interdigital transducer (IDT) microelectrode and platinum resistor array chip

timing.protocol_description: Four LIPUS parameter sets (US1-US4, listed in supplementary Table S1) were applied to Mg2+-free epileptic neuron cultures on a surface acoustic wave chip; 1 MHz, 30 kPa and 30% duty cycle is the parameter set the abstract reports as suppressing discharges; US2 was applied for 5 min in the heating test.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Further, using an on-chip epileptic neuronal model, it was found that ultrasound with parameters of 1 MHz frequency, 30 kPa pressure, and 30% duty cycle efectively suppressed neuronal epileptiform discharges.
